CBMPy Documentation

CBMPy is a platform for constraint-based modelling and analysis of biological systems. It implements Flux Balance Analysis (FBA), Flux Variability Analysis (FVA), and other constraint-based methods using linear and mixed-integer programming.

Quick Start

After installing CBMPy:

import cbmpy

# Read a model from SBML
cmod = cbmpy.readSBML3FBC('example_model.xml')

# Perform Flux Balance Analysis
result = cbmpy.doFBA(cmod)

# Print the optimal objective value
print(f"Optimal flux: {result[0]}")
